# checkmk_host_group (Resource)

Manages a CheckMK host group. Host groups provide logical grouping of hosts independent of folder hierarchy. Does not require activation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic host group
resource "checkmk_host_group" "webservers" {
  name  = "webservers"
  alias = "Web Servers"
}
```

```terraform
# Multiple host groups for infrastructure organization
resource "checkmk_host_group" "databases" {
  name  = "databases"
  alias = "Database Servers"
}

resource "checkmk_host_group" "loadbalancers" {
  name  = "loadbalancers"
  alias = "Load Balancers"
}

resource "checkmk_host_group" "network_devices" {
  name  = "network_devices"
  alias = "Network Infrastructure"
}

resource "checkmk_host_group" "storage" {
  name  = "storage"
  alias = "Storage Systems"
}

resource "checkmk_host_group" "kubernetes" {
  name  = "kubernetes"
  alias = "Kubernetes Nodes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Human-readable alias/title for the host group.
- `name` (String) Unique name for the host group. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `strict_resource_locking` (Boolean) Override provider-level strict_resource_locking for this resource. Controls ETag validation for resource operations. If not set, uses provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the host group (same as name).
